ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT (this “Agreement"), made as of October ZY, 2012, by and between 150 Richardson St, LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 336 Atlantic Avenue, East Rockaway, New York 11518 ("Purchaser") and Paris Dalto, Joseph Dalto, Raymond Dalto Sr., a/k/a Raymond Dalto, and Raymond Dalto Jr., having an address of 148 Richardson Street, Brooklyn, New York 11211 (each, individually and collectively the “Seller"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Sellers Paris Dalto and Joseph Dalto are the owners in fee title and Sellers Raymond Dalto Sr. and Raymond Dalto Jr. are each holders of a life estate of a parcel of land in Brooklyn, New York,known as and by the street address 148 Richardson Street, Brooklyn,New York, designated as Block 2734, Lot 17 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as the “Seller Land"; the improvements currently existing thereupon as of the date hereof, the “Seller Building”and, the Seller Land and the Seller Building, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as the “Seller Property"); and WHEREAS, the Purchaser is the owner in fee title of a parcel of land in Brooklyn, New York, known as and by the street address, 150 Richardson Street, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Block 2734, Lot 18 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, Kings County, and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land being hereinafter referred to as the “Purchaser Land" and, together with any building or improvements placed thereon ("Purchaser Building") hereinafter referred to as, the “Purchaser Property"; the Seller Land and the Purchaser Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels" and each individually as a “Parcel'"); and WHEREAS, the Purchaser intends to construct a.new building on the Purchaser Land (the "Project") that will contain more “floor area" as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961, as amended to the date hereof (the “Zoning Resolution') than is now available for use under the “floor area ratio" limitation contained in the Zoning Resolution related to Purchaser Property as an independent zoning lot; and WHEREAS, the Purchaser and the Seller desire to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for declaring the Purchaser Land and the Seller Land to be a single zoning lot and transferring one thousand square feet of development rights (the “Transferred Excess Development Rights"), which are appurtenant to the Seller Land and not utilized by the existing 4-story residential building on the Seller Land (i.e., the Seller Building) or retained by the Seller for future use by the Seller (the “Retained Development Rights"), to the Purchaser Land for incorporation into theProject. NOW THEREFORE, in consideration of the foregoing and other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which is hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree asfollows:
